subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: Mohsin said to the thief, "Speak the truth. I will not punish you. I shall try to help you." The thief said, "Sir, I am very poor. I have no food to give my wife and children. They are crying for food."
guide_solution: Change the narrative style (Direct to Indirect Speech): Mohsin told the thief to speak the truth and assured him that he would not punish him but would try to help him. The thief replied respectfully that he was very poor and had no food to give his wife and children, who were crying for food.
